label: Toutatis system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Toutatis locus represented by TutA_VCA0446 and TutB_VCA0447 profiles that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Toutatis branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual TutA_VCA0446 or TutB_VCA0447 genes, TutA_VCA0446 or TutB_VCA0447 proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Toutatis locus, unresolved Toutatis trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
